parallels.note: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.

translations.web: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
translations.bsb: But if your eyes are bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!
translations.kjv: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!
